en: An AI agent was asked to buy 2 GPU hours from a cheaper seller that is not on the list. The vault on TRON refused, and recorded the stop on-chain.
Kiln's Qwen3-32B explains it in plain words. It is shown only because it repeats the audit's verdict.
This is the vault's public event: SpendBlocked, with the receipt hash and the reason. Anyone can read it. No key needed.
This is Spendline, a wallet and policy layer for an AI purchasing agent. A person draws the line. The agent only asks. The vault decides.
The person sets a budget, a per-payment cap, the sellers, and a deadline, one short step at a time.
Then signs it with the owner key, on their own machine. STOP is signed the same way.
The feed shows spending against the line, newest first: paid, or stopped with a reason.
Over budget once the fee is added: stopped on-chain.
The person can press STOP at any time. The next payment was stopped as PAUSED, on-chain.
A short time window: one payment inside it, then the same request after it closed. Stopped: deadline passed.
Now the audit, rebuilt from public records only: 21 receipts, 13 paid inside, 8 stopped, 0 problems.
The same check from the command line. No key. It re-hashes every receipt and replays the line in force at that moment.

New in this version: any agent that speaks MCP can use Spendline as its wallet. Here the host's planner is Qwen3-32B on Kiln, live on the organizer's account. One request, three pay calls: the GPU Shop and the Kiln credit were paid, and the unknown seller was stopped on-chain.

And a second witness. Each receipt hash on TRON commits to the Kiln generation behind it, and Kiln's own record agrees on 15 of 15 calls: model, tokens and cost. Every model call came 2 to 5 seconds before its payment.
A teammate asks: did we pay that cheap unknown seller? Kiln picks the receipt. The verdict comes from the audit, never from the model.
On Friday, one command writes the statement: paid by seller, 18.20 USDT kept in the vault by 8 stops, and a CSV for the accountant. Tune shows what next week's line would have done.
Efficiency: 1.00 LLM call per purchase. With no-think, median output drops from 223 to 36 tokens, the same JSON in 12 of 12 pairs. Energy is an estimate: 180 watts times measured time.
Spendline. Not an agent that can pay, but a payment that can prove it was allowed.
